text:
maria: heads up — rerank eval CI failed on main with a surprising NDCG drop for the new quantized model. failing in mteb shard runner.
kevin: ugh, saw the alert. can you paste the failing log lines?
maria: yes — relevant excerpt below:

ci-bot: TEST_RUN  -> runner/shard=12 shards_total=128
ci-bot: ERROR -> shard_key_mismatch: expected_shard=127 actual_shard=12
ci-bot: METRIC -> ndcg@10: 0.217 (baseline 0.431)

maria: looks like our shard-key calculation is picking up the wrong hash seed after the quantize job. happens only on the runner in CI, not locally.
sophia: could this be the deterministic hashing change from the last PR? 1719 changed the salt for embeddings.
kevin: yes — PR #1719 replaced Murmur3 with xxhash for perf. the eval harness assumed murmur3 mod shards. the runner was updated but the shard-key util in the mteb adapter wasn't.
maria: repro steps I used locally:
1) checkout main
2) run `./scripts/run_mteb.sh --shards 128 --shard 127 --model quantized-v2`
3) observe empty hits for many queries

maria: here's the minimal snippet where the bug surfaces:
```python
def shard_for_key(key, shards):
    # previously: murmur3_32(key) % shards
    return xxhash.xxh64(key).intdigest() % shards
```

maria: the adapter still calls `murmur3_mod(key, shards)` so we get mismatched routing when jobs run across components.
kevin: that explains why only CI (where components are mixed versions) fails.
sophia: quick mitigation: add a compatibility shim in the adapter that detects a header `hash-algo: murmur3` and falls back. then we can coordinate a rollout.
james: agree. we should also add a unit test that asserts same shard decisions across adapter + runner for a sample set.
ci-bot: NEW ISSUE created: infra/embeddings#432 - shard-key-compatibility-mismatch
maria: I'll open a small PR with the shim + tests. linking draft: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/embeddings/pull/98
kevin: add an integration CI job: run cross-component hash parity check in matrix (runner version x adapter version combinations).
sophia: also add a dashboard alert for sudden per-shard empty-hit-rate spike — that would have caught this earlier.
kevin: +1. for the NDCG regression we should run a targeted backfill to confirm scope before rollback.
james: FYI, I pushed a tiny fix to the adapter in the draft — simple murmur3 fallback when header present. local tests pass.
maria: thanks. i'll kick the CI on the PR and watch the ndcg numbers. will revert if anything else pops.
kevin: thanks all. follow-up tasks: (1) cross-component parity job, (2) add parity unit tests, (3) dashboard spike alert, (4) coordinate phased rollout of xxhash across infra. i'll create a ticket for the rollout plan.
sophia: tagging platform@ here — we may want to schedule a short maintenance window for the rollout to avoid mixed-version spikes.
maria: CI rerun shows green on the PR and ndcg@10 back to baseline on the check-run. closing for now but leaving infra/embeddings#432 open until rollout done. :thumbsup:
